visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long blonde hair and a red bow in her hair, wearing a white tube top, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a green and white box labeled JOLEN CREME BLEACH towards the camera while smiling and gesturing. (2) She brings the box closer to the camera to show the labels and product name clearly. (3) The camera cuts to a close-up of her face as she points to her eyebrows, which are currently dark and contrast with her hair. (4) She opens the box and removes a small clear plastic mixing cup and a white plastic spatula. (5) She opens a white jar and uses the spatula to scoop a white cream into the mixing cup, then adds white powder from a smaller tube. (6) She mixes the two components in the cup until they form a thick white paste. (7) She carefully applies the white paste onto her right eyebrow with the spatula, covering it completely. (8) A split-screen comparison appears showing a close-up of her face with the treated eyebrow labeled After and her original dark eyebrow labeled Before. (9) She applies the cream to her left eyebrow while holding the two product jars in front of her face. (10) The video concludes with her giving two thumbs-up to the camera with a satisfied expression, with pink heart graphics appearing around her.

(2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect highlights the appearance of text on screen as the box rustles. (3) The vocal switches to a narrative style as she describes her past experiences with hair bleach; music maintains steady volume. (4) A 'clink' sound occurs as she opens the plastic box. (5) Audible rustling and plastic tapping follow as she handles the mixing cup and spatula. (6) A consistent 'swishing' and 'scraping' sound of mixing thick cream in a cup is clearly heard. (7) A 'ding' sound effect coincides with the application of the cream to her face. (8) Strategic use of a 'boing' cartoon sound effect marks the transition to the before/after reveal. (9) The music swells and ends with a bright chime as she gives her final enthusiastic recommendation.
